title: Analysis: Where does Coty's new Fragrance Club initiative fit post-Gucci loss?
summary: As Coty navigates the loss of its Gucci Beauty licence, the launch of the giant’s new Fragrance Club signals a strategic push to strengthen its fragrance expertise and gain a competitive edge in the hotly contested perfume segment
